description: This file defines a parser for the PHC string format, including data structures for PHC strings and a parser class with methods to parse and validate PHC strings.

classes.name: PHC
classes.description: Represents a PHC string with its components: Id, Version, Params, Salt, Hash.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A parser class that reads input and parses it into a PHC object.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Parser instance with input limited to MaxRunes.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses an expected token or identifier from the input.

methods.name: parseFunctionId
methods.description: Parses a function ID starting with '$' followed by a function identifier.

methods.name: parseHash
methods.description: Parses a base64-encoded hash and ensures it is at the end of input.

methods.name: parseParamRHS
methods.description: Parses an '=' followed by a parameter value.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main method to parse the input into a PHC object, handling all parts of the PHC string format.
